The '''CP-3.3 hologram projector''' was a model of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] manufactured by [[Corellidyne Visuals]]. It was capable of creating a lifelike [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] through advances in image output, projection density, and light manipulation. Originally intended for use within the entertainment industry, the CP-3.3 hologram projector also found use in military simulations. A miniaturized version of the projector was built into Corellidyne's [[CQ-3.9x holographic image disguiser]].<ref name="EGWT" />
